title: Rolling Too Far? A price increase before delivery
shortTitle: Rolling Too Far? A price increase before delivery
summary: After charging the customer’s card at the agreed price but before delivery, the seller demands more money.
notes: If Hill places formation after the review period, what explains a binding obligation to ship at the earlier price? Does the proposed resolution fit § 2-207’s treatment of formation? Distinguish an implication of a theory from a result the court actually decided.
